name: Server IP
description: Displays the server's IP address (e.g. for debugging load-balanced setups).
project_description:
Server IP is a simple module it will display the ip address of the server. Nowadays most of the sites using the cloud servers with more than one IP address for different region for the same site.It will be helpful for developers to debug the IP address of cloud server that contains more than one ip address for single site.

 We have two options to view the variables,

 Default Option : 
 Developers can also view the below details by default for easily debugging :

 
 Database Host Name 
 Database Name 
 Current Theme 
 Path To Theme 
 Base Url 
 
 User Select Option : 
 User can able to select the PHP $_SERVER variables in the configuration form. The selected variables will be displayed in the server details menu.

 Back to top 

 Usage : 
 The place of the menu link has been changed in this release.

 The menu navigation for settings and details page as below

 Server Settings : Configuration -> Server Settings

 Server Details: Configuration -> Server Settings -> Server Details

 By default, administrator role can access this url. If we want to access those url to different role, go to permission page and find the word 'View Server Details' and 'Edit Server Settings' to set the permission for different role. 

 Back to top
